description: Defines data structures and a class for loading unit conversion data within the CalculatorApp, including OrderedUnit, UnitData, ExplicitUnitConversionData, and the UnitConverterDataLoader class implementing IConverterDataLoader.

classes.name: UnitConverterDataLoader
classes.description: Loads unit conversion data for a specific geographic region, implementing the IConverterDataLoader interface.

methods.name: GetOrderedCategories
methods.description: Retrieves categories in a specific order.

methods.name: GetOrderedUnits
methods.description: Retrieves units within a category in a specific order.

methods.name: LoadOrderedRatios
methods.description: Loads conversion ratios for a given unit.

methods.name: SupportsCategory
methods.description: Checks if a category is supported.

methods.name: GetExplicitConversionData
methods.description: Populates explicit conversion data between units.

methods.name: GetLocalizedStringName
methods.description: Retrieves localized string name for a given string ID.
